about: src/lib/reconcile_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file (the backend and the POS core run the same close check from madar-till). It is pinned to a commit, not a tag, until the next madar-shared tag; then the tag replaces the commit here. A change is made there and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it, and features/tills/util.test.ts runs the close dialog's check against it.
